label: Gala Peter
note: Daniel Peter's milk chocolate, 1887, the first eating milk chocolate brand; named from the Greek word for milk; Peter first made milk chocolate in 1875 with Henri Nestlé's condensed milk

about.text: The first milk chocolate sold for eating, made by Daniel Peter of Vevey from 1887 (he had solved the problem in 1875 using condensed milk from his neighbour Henri Nestlé).
